ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, senior management and all ultimate beneficial owners against the Samoan domestic sanctions list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals List, UK HM Treasury sanctions list, and the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List. Politically Exposed Persons are identified through commercial databases and extended due diligence is required for any PEP, their family members, and known close associates. Continuous transaction monitoring and adverse media screening are required under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry – Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be registered in English using Latin alphabet characters. Samoan words must be reproduced in accordance with standard Samoan orthography; a company name must consist solely of permissible characters, numbers and spacing, and an International Company must include the suffix 'International Company', 'IC', 'Limited' or 'Ltd'. Names that are misleading, offensive, or contrary to public policy will be refused.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar refuses a proposed name, the applicant or licensed registered agent may, within 14 days of the notice of refusal, file a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies, setting out the legal grounds for admissibility and proposing a revised name. If the Registrar upholds the refusal, a further appeal may be made to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days. No new government fee is charged for a first administrative appeal; a nominal fee applies for second-tier ministerial review.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are not recognized as satisfying the statutory registered office requirement for an International Company in Samoa. A physical registered office maintained by a licensed registered agent in Samoa is mandatory. Virtual office services may be used only for supplementary administrative and general contact purposes outside Samoa.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5–10% annual probability) for a low-risk online cosmetics retail entity with no physical warehouse or cash processing presence; likelihood may increase to 20–30% upon any change in the AML/CFT risk profile, sanctions screening hit, or regulatory notice under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), ss 6, 8, 10, 12, and 42; International Companies Regulations 1988, regs 5–9; Samoa International Finance Authority Act 2005, s 9
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; at least one share must be issued and the consideration may be fixed by the first directors. No escrow account or deposit is required for an ordinary International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company adopt the registered office situated at [address, Apia, Samoa] as the Company’s registered office in accordance with section 12 of the International Companies Act 1987. RESOLVED FURTHER that the subscribers set out in the memorandum subscribe for the issued ordinary shares of the Company as recorded in the register of members and that the first directors determine the consideration payable therefor. RESOLVED FURTHER that the following persons be and are hereby appointed as the first directors, secretary, and resident agent: [Names], each to serve until replaced in accordance with the articles. RESOLVED FURTHER that the officers are authorized to execute all documents and pay all fees necessary to obtain the Certificate of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — Companies Registry Online Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a preliminary name search electronically through the SIFA Companies Registry portal or by written request to the Registrar of International Companies. Propose one primary and two alternative names. Ensure the name ends with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain a name reservation certificate, which is valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (Form IC-0)
Certificate of good standing of any parent company (if applying to use a parent-group name)
Proof of payment of name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusingly similar, submit a revised name with a distinguishing descriptor within 14 days. The resubmission is treated as a fresh application; the original fee is credited toward the new filing if made within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA-licensed Incorporation Agent (acting on behalf of subscribers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the memorandum and articles of association in the form prescribed by the Registrar of International Companies. The memorandum must state the company name, registered office address, share structure, and details of the initial subscriber. Have the subscriber, or an authorized officer of a corporate subscriber, execute the charter documents before a notary public or a person duly authorized to administer oaths in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Executed memorandum of association
Executed articles of association
Subscriber identity and address verification (passport and proof of address)
Power of attorney or corporate authorization if execution is made by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA queries the charter documents for inconsistencies in share allotment, subscribe to, or article wording, file a corrective execution page or a short-form deed of amendment. SIFA will recommence review without requiring a full re-filing if the application fee remains unaffected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing with the Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation application package to the Registrar together with the executed charter documents, subscriber consents, registered office consent, and certified identification of the first directors and secretary. Pay the government incorporation fee plus any applicable stamp duty. The Registrar will examine the application for compliance with sections 8 and 12 of the International Companies Act 1987 and the International Companies Regulations 1988.
required_dossiers: Completed Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation)
Memorandum and articles of association
Consent to act as director from each first director
Consent to act as secretary and/or resident agent, as applicable
Consent of registered office provider
Certified copies of passports or national identity cards of all first officers
Government fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a notice of defect, provide the specified corrective information or evidence of compliance within 21 days. Failure to cure results in automatic withdrawal, but the applicant may reinstate the same application within 28 days by filing a reinstatement request with a waiver of the repeat filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority — Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of the Registrar, the company is immediately registered and a Certificate of Incorporation bearing the seal of SIFA is issued. Thereafter, the resident agent must establish the statutory registers at the registered office, including the register of members, register of directors and officers, minutes of directors' meetings, and the company seal. The initial registered office address is deemed effective from the date of the certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued by Registrar)
Notice of address of registered office
Initial register of members and allotment sheet
Consent forms of officers and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical variances relative to the approved memorandum, file a rectification application under section 22 of the International Companies Act 1987. The Registrar will reissue a corrected certificate within 5 working days after the application is lodged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation First Board Resolution and Officer Notices
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent (SIFA-licensed) and Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 14 days of incorporation, convene the first board meeting (which may be by written resolution) to adopt the registered office, confirm the share subscription and allotment, ratify the first directors and officers, authorize banking arrangements, and approve the issue of share certificates. File the officers and registered office notice with the Registrar within 21 days of the allotment, using Form IC-2, and ensure the statutory registers are updated accordingly.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting or written unanimous resolution
Share certificates and share transfer/issue register
Form IC-2 (Notice of directors and secretary/resident agent)
Registered office consent letter from the registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing of officer notices attracts a penalty. To cure the default, file a notice of late filing with a sworn explanation and pay the late fee. Upon acceptance, the Registrar records the officers with effect from the original appointment date, preserving the company's good standing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no manufacturing, industrial, or physical production activity is conducted under ISIC 4791 online retail; Samoa does not require an industrial licence for offshore international companies engaged solely in e-commerce retail.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No separate operating or manufacturing permit required for pure online retail of cosmetics and personal care products. If the company later establishes a physical retail storefront in Samoa, a Business Licence from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) would be required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa — Environment and Conservation Division
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — operations are limited to online retail with no manufacturing, processing, or industrial discharge; no Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) report or registration is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the current online retail scope. If the company later introduces warehousing or repackaging in Samoa, it must comply with the Waste Management Act 2010 and the Samoa National Environment Standards, including wastewater biological oxygen demand (BOD) ≤ 50 mg/L, proper storage of cosmetic products to prevent VOC emissions, and licensed disposal of hazardous waste through an approved waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No physical premises or industrial operations are required for an offshore International Company engaged in online retail. If the company later leases an office or warehouse in Samoa, it must obtain a building occupancy permit and a Fire Clearance Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA), and comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2006 and the Accident Compensation Act 2010, including a workplace safety inspection and employee accident compensation registration.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Samoa — Commissioner of Revenue; official portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws (MfR e-Services platform for TIN issuance, GST and income tax returns, and customs-related filings).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Samoa International Company (IC), the licensed registered agent submits the prescribed tax registration application to the Ministry for Revenue together with the Certificate of Incorporation issued under the International Companies Act 1987, Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered-agent consent, certified passport copies of directors/shareholders, and registered office address confirmation; no physical presence or local employees are required for an offshore-only IC. The MfR issues the Tax Identification Number (TIN) within 3-5 working days. Separate GST registration is triggered only where the entity makes or intends to make taxable supplies in Samoa exceeding the WST 100,000 threshold; an IC conducting wholly offshore beauty DTC retail is not obliged to register for GST unless goods are imported into or supplied within Samoa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch classification election exists under Samoa law. An IC is statutorily exempt from income tax, GST, stamp duty, and other taxes on international business under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended). Optional elections include voluntary GST registration under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003 (enabling input credit recovery but taxing Samoa supplies) and conversion into a domestic company under the Companies Act 2006, which subjects the entity to standard domestic entity-level taxation (corporate income tax at the prevailing 27% rate) and extinguishes IC statutory exemptions. The General Anti-Avoidance Rule under the Tax Administration Act 2012 and CFC rules in the Income Tax Act 2012 apply to prevent abuse of IC status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (Samoa Tala) of taxable supplies in Samoa in a 12-month period; voluntary registration is permitted
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No national real-time e-invoicing or fiscal clearance mandate is currently in force (no API clearance, digital stamping, or fiscal cash-register integration). GST-registered suppliers must issue prescribed tax invoices in paper or PDF form under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003 and file GST returns electronically (monthly, with quarterly arrangements available) via the MfR e-Services portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under section 9 of the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003: (i) goods physically exported from Samoa within 28 days of the time of supply (or such longer period as the Commissioner approves), provided the supplier retains documentary proof of export; and (ii) services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Samoa at the time of supply and where the benefit is used or consumed entirely outside Samoa. For ISIC 4791 online cosmetics retail, direct-to-consumer shipments delivered to overseas customers qualify for the 0% GST rate if the IC is GST-registered; where goods are sourced and dropshipped entirely outside Samoa, no Samoa GST arises because no taxable supply occurs in Samoa. Zero-rating requires simultaneously holding contemporaneous export documentation and, for refund claims, that any excess input credits are substantiated and claimed in the GST return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusDEC) lodged electronically with Samoa Customs (Ministry for Revenue)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical exportation from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds through the Samoa financial system
Commercial invoice and purchase order or sales contract (matched to the CusDEC)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to MfR post-clearance audit. A false or unsupported zero-rating claim triggers immediate clawback of the unremitted GST plus interest and shortfall penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2012: 20% for failure to take reasonable care, 40% for recklessness, and up to 150% for intentional evasion, together with monthly late-payment penalties of 1.5%. Criminal prosecution for tax evasion carries fines up to WST 100,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years. The Customs Act 2014 separately imposes false-declaration penalties of up to 200% of duty evaded and forfeiture of goods. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days (administered by the Central Bank of Samoa under the Exchange Control Act 1975) may result in loss of zero-rating, customs valuation adjustments, and monetary penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) — the sole exchange-control authority, administering the Exchange Control Act 1976, the Exchange Control Regulations, and CBS directions issued to licensed commercial banks acting as authorised dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is non-internationalised and administratively managed. Current-account payments may be processed by authorised dealers with CBS reporting forms, whereas capital-account transactions (equity injections, shareholder loans, dividend and profit remittances) require prior CBS approval or an authorised-dealer coded authorisation. Profit remittance by a WS International Company requires audited financial statements, tax and economic-substance confirmation, and a completed Exchange Control outbound form; there is no deep offshore WST market, so USD-denominated settlement through correspondent chains is recommended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must repatriate export proceeds into Samoa through an authorised dealer within the CBS-prescribed timeline, generally within three months from shipment, and surrender foreign currency at the mandatory conversion ratio of 100% where proceeds fund domestic WST obligations. A CBS 'direction to retain' may permit an offshore-model International Company to hold receipts in an external foreign-currency account, subject to monthly returns and supporting export documentation; late surrender invokes CBS penalty administration.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and USD-denominated Operational Account with WST conversion sub-limit

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account, multi-currency USD allocation, and remittance-coded workflows
Operational Account (domestically oriented, limited proprietary cross-border trade product set)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa has no EMI licensing regime, and offshore digital EMIs are not authorised dealers under CBS exchange control; they cannot hold WST or perform Samoan clearing. A WS International Company may use Shopify Payments and PayPal strictly as front-end collection aggregators, but all net treasury sweeps must settle into a CBS-licensed authorised-dealer account; routing core liquidity through an offshore EMI would constitute an exchange-control breach.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and CBS AML/CFT guidelines do not statutorily require a physical interview for non-resident companies, but Samoan banks in practice impose risk-based remote onboarding with a live video identity attestation of directors and UBOs plus notarised or apostilled corporate documents. Where remote attestation is not accepted, one director visit to Apia is mandated before account activation; positive SIFA good-standing evidence and confirmation that the International Company does not trade domestically are additional condition precedents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore International Company presenting shell-risk substance deficiencies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current-year SIFA registration certificate, certificate of good standing, certificate of incumbency, full UBO register, Apia physical-lease and service-provider agreement, staffing or outsourced substance evidence, and a written explanation of the DTC beauty-retail operating model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed payment-chain aggregation through Shopify Payments and PayPal producing e-money and peer-to-peer suspicion
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Domain ownership and store screenshots, Shopify Merchant ID and six-month settlement history, PayPal business verification, published refund, chargeback and privacy policies, independent restricted-party screening tool confirmation, and a diagram showing all fund flows converging on a CBS authorised dealer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner opacity linked to Hong Kong or Chinese diaspora import and marketing counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport and residential address evidence for every 10% or greater UBO, identity-change documentation where mismatches exist, source-of-wealth profile for any USD 50,000 or larger infusion, supplier business licence and registration trail, and a bank-furnished introduction or reference letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cosmetics beauty-retail trade lane triggering product-license, ingredient, and sanctions-adjacent checks
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Material safety data sheets and ingredient registrations, ISO/GMP certificates where applicable, export and import licences for target consumer markets, affirmation that ISIC 4791 requires no statutory retail licence in Samoa, and an internal red-flag matrix demonstrating no restricted counterparty trade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign-exchange purpose-code mismatch causing CBS outward-payment suspension or remittance quarantine
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A treasury desk-to-bank payment coding manual mapping ISO and MT purpose codes to equity, trade, tax and hedging flows, executed counterparty contracts for each material payment clique, and a first-month bank compliance briefing pack containing pre-completed CBS forms.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route equity injections by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 cover to the International Company's authorised-dealer account under purpose code 'Equity injection — direct investment in WS International Company' with a supporting BPM6-equity narrative; deliver a board resolution authorising share issuance, a CBS capital-import application or approval where threshold-triggered, the bank's inward foreign-exchange declaration, and remitter UBO and AML evidence. The payment description must not refer to 'trade settlement', and upon receipt the bank issues a Foreign Exchange Transaction Advice to serve as the audit artefact.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier procurement for cosmetics inventory and logistics is cleared via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 customer credits and, for larger purchase orders, through commercial documentary Letters of Credit issued under UCP600 on a sight basis; each payment requires the underlying invoice, pro-forma contract, export documentation, and a CBS outward-remittance form coded for goods trade. Shopify Payments and PayPal refunds and chargebacks are netted in the acquiring settlement ledger with periodic sweeps to the Samoan operating account, and any net cross-border movement above USD 10,000 is aggregated and reported to CBS by the authorised dealer.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX forwards executed with a Samoan authorised dealer, maximum tenor 12 months, fully tied to documented inventory-purchase and cart-currency revenue underlyings, settled gross on maturity and disclosed to CBS on the applicable return.

Cross-currency swaps arranged through a licensed bank counterparty only after CBS pre-approval, used solely to hedge balance-sheet capital or intercompany lending exposure of the WS International Company.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards in WST are not permissible for Samoan-regulated users; any offshore WST NDF service falls outside CBS licensing and would be treated as an unlawful avoidance of exchange control.

USD or AUD European-style options executed via the bank's offshore treasury desk and booked as off-balance-sheet derivative exposure in the International Company's treasury ledger with CBS event-notification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Registrar of International Companies (SIFA – Companies Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 50 per month; persistent non‑filing beyond 3 months triggers administrative strike‑off and cancellation of tax exemption.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 31 March of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Interest at 10% per annum on unpaid fee; continued default leads to strike‑off and loss of legal existence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (licensed Samoan service provider) – reciprocal copy to Registrar on request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent results in automatic administrative dissolution by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is imposed on Samoa International Companies. An independent audit is only required if the company's articles of association expressly mandate it or if the International Finance Authority issues a direction based on a business risk profile.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) applied for internal accounting purposes; statutory records need not be filed with SIFA but must be retained.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain a written annual confirmation from the directors or beneficial owners verifying the UBO register. Any share transfer or change in substantial ownership must be notified by the company to the registered agent within 14 days of the event; the agent updates the beneficial ownership register accordingly.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,200 (market range per licensed Samoan registered agent)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; voluntary audit fee estimated USD 2,500 – USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company (IC) full exemption from Samoa corporate income tax on foreign-sourced income under International Companies Act 1987; exemption from withholding tax on dividends, interest, and royalties; no capital gains tax; no exchange control restrictions; statutory tax holiday for IC register.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) Corporate Income Tax Return (Form IR-1), filed electronically via SRA Online Tax Portal (e-Services).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar year taxpayers, no later than 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Identification: enter the 7-digit IRD number, legal name, trading name, and registered office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For International Company (IC), enter Samoa registered agent's address and IC registration number; if no IRD, register via SRA taxpayer portal before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting Period: state the commencement and closing dates of the income year (maximum 12 months).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Align reporting period with IC annual return filing under International Companies Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business Income / Gross Revenue: report gross turnover from online cosmetics and personal care retail sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC deriving only foreign-source income: write 'Exempt - IC Offshore Income' and attach exemption schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses and Deductions: report deductible operating expenses (inventory, logistics, marketing, administrative).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC claiming exemption: itemise expenses on attachment solely to substantiate economic substance, even when not taxable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable Income / Loss: gross profit minus allowable deductions; negative amount is a tax loss.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: taxable income in Samoa is nil; enter 0 and attach memorandum of offshore income and economic substance report.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Payable / Refund: apply headline rate to taxable income, deduct payments and credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: enter 0, supported by exemption certificate under International Companies Act 1987.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification: signature of director and Samoan registered agent, with agent licence number and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Authorised local agent must co-sign; include agent's Samoa licence number.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of WST 1,000 or 10% of tax due, whichever is higher, plus 2% monthly surcharge on unpaid tax (maximum 25%); late payment interest of 1% per month; penalties apply equally to IC filings even when tax payable is zero.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% for resident company distributions; 0% for International Company dividends paid to non-residents.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain Samoa Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from SRA by filing Form TR-10; submit TRC with DTA relief claim (Form WHT-5) to the paying agent before distribution or within 30 days after; for ICs, substitute International Company exemption certificate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: royalties 15%, interest 15% for non-residents; DTA-reduced rates: royalties 5-10%, interest 5-10%, conditionally on TRC submission; ICs wholly exempt from both.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 per annum for related-party transactions triggering mandatory Local File / Master File under SRA Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IC-specific threshold applies only when Economic Substance filing is activated.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 apply. For online beauty retail distribution and service centre activities, the IC must demonstrate core income-generating activities, physical regulated premises, full-time qualified employees, and local management in Samoa; annual ESR notification and substance report must be filed with the Samoa International Companies Registry.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting taxable profits on Form IR-1, false deductions, or concealing in-Samoa retail revenue while claiming IC exemption for what is actually domestic sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to WST 100,000 plus 200% of understated tax; imprisonment up to 7 years under Samoa Tax Administration Act 2012.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax through civil recovery; travel restriction orders; disqualification as director; criminal prosecution of each signing director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining IC registration with no physical premises, no employees, no local management in Samoa; operating DTC cosmetics business exclusively from foreign directors; failing ESR notification and substance filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Annual penalty of WST 20,000 per IC, plus WST 5,000 per director and registered agent for ESR non-compliance; involuntary strike-off and deregistration of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil: directors personally liable for all profits reclassified as Samoa-source taxable income; personal liability for statutory penalties; prohibition from re-incorporation in Samoa for 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manipulating intercompany pricing for branded cosmetics, royalty payments, and logistics fees between the Samoa IC and affiliated overseas suppliers to shift profits and avoid arm's length standards.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP adjustment to arm's length consideration; taxation of adjusted profit at 27%; additional penalty of 40% on the additional tax due.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify materially incorrect local file or TP documentation expose personal liability to SRA for recovery; referral to criminal prosecutor for certification offences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file beneficial ownership particulars with the Samoa registered agent; conducting high-volume cash-like retail sales and layering proceeds through PayPal and Shopify without customer due diligence or AML controls.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to WST 500,000 and revocation of registered agent licence under Samoa AML/CFT (Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism) Act; freezing of company bank accounts; criminal asset seizure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors personally liable for laundered funds repatriation; bank account freezing and assets restraint; imprisonment up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing profits to non-resident shareholders without deducting 15% withholding tax on false grounds of treaty exemption or IC exemption where it does not apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of unpaid withholding tax at 15% plus late payment penalty of 100% of the unpaid amount and accruing interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors jointly and severally liable as withholding agents; civil recovery against personal assets; travel ban for acting director until restitution.
